hits.title: Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company’s Growth | Scale AI
hits.snippet: Scale AI today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Francis deSouza as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 10, 2026. The appointment comes as Scale's momentum accelerates, with customer growth across both its data and applications businesses. Recent wins include the addition of enterprise customers such as BP and Mayo Clinic, along with expanded business with both U.S. and international governments. Jason Droege, who has led the company as interim CEO since June 2025, will work closely with Francis over the coming months to help with the transition.

hits.title: Scale AI Appoints Francis deSouza as CEO to Lead Next Phase of Company's Growth
hits.snippet: SAN FRANCISCO, July 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Scale AI today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Francis deSouza as Chief Executive Officer, effective August 10, 2026. The appointment comes as Scale's momentum accelerates, with customer growth across both its data and applications businesses. Recent wins include the addition of enterprise customers such as BP and Mayo Clinic, along with expanded business with both U.S. and international governments. Jason Droege, who has led the company as interim CEO since June 2025, will work closely with Francis over the coming months to help with the transition.

hits.title: Alexandr Wang, Chief AI Officer
hits.snippet: Alexandr Wang, Chief AI Officer ... # Alexandr Wang ... ## Chief AI Officer ... Alexandr Wang joined Meta in June 2025 as the company’s first-ever Chief AI Officer, where he leads Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL). As Chief AI Officer, Alexandr plays an integral role in shaping Meta’s AI vision and driving its strategic initiatives from concept to execution. Prior to Meta, Alexandr founded Scale AI in 2016 as a 19-year-old MIT student with the vision of providing the critical data and infrastructure needed for complex AI projects. Under his leadership, Scale AI grew to nearly a $29 billion valuation and was involved in the development of most every leading model across the industry.

hits.title: Alexandr Wang
hits.snippet: Alexandr Wang (Chinese: 汪滔; pinyin: Wāng Tāo; born January 1997) is an American entrepreneur. He has been the chief AI officer of Meta Platforms since 2025 and leads its Superintelligence Labs. He is the co-founder and former CEO of Scale AI, an artificial intelligence company that provides data labeling and large language model evaluation services to develop AI applications.
